import os,stat,json
from pathlib import Path
patterns={
"telegram_opt":"/opt/telegram-robot-leads",
"hopper_opt":"/opt/hopper",
"codex_home":"/home/ubuntu/codex-agent",
"codex_bridge":"/home/ubuntu/codex-bridge",
"codex_projects":"/srv/projects/codex-agent",
"ferrari_home":"/home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari",
"rea_original":"/home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680",
"rea_runtime":"/home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime",
"rea_evidence":"/home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680-evidence",
"lowcost_etc":"/etc/lowcost-europa",
"pink_alias":"/srv/pink-iptv",
"telegram_old_status":"optin/scripts/telegram-iptvpn-status.sh",
"telegram_old_wrapper":"optin/scripts/telegram-robot-leads-status.sh"}
roots=["/srv/projects","/etc/systemd/system","/lib/systemd/system","/etc/nginx","/etc/cron.d","/etc/cron.daily","/etc/cron.weekly","/etc/cron.monthly","/usr/local/bin","/usr/local/sbin"]
prune={".git",".venv","venv","node_modules",".runtime","archive","backups","backup",".cache","data","private","evidence","logs","tmp","temp","dist","build",".npm",".gradle",".terraform",".next",".pytest_cache",".mypy_cache","__pycache__","screenshots","test-results","reports"}
allowed={".py",".sh",".js",".json",".yml",".yaml",".service",".timer",".conf",".socket",".toml",".md",".txt",".ini",".cfg",".env",".ts"}
stats={"files_seen":0,"files_scanned":0,"skipped_large":0,"truncated":False}
hits={key:[] for key in patterns}
limit=35000
for base in roots:
 if not os.path.isdir(base):continue
 for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(base,followlinks=False):
  dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in prune and not d.startswith(".telegram-leads-") and not d.startswith("ferrari-requests") and not d.startswith(".git")]
  for name in files:
   stats["files_seen"]+=1
   if stats["files_seen"]>limit:stats["truncated"]=True;break
   p=os.path.join(folder,name)
   if p.endswith(".zip") or p.endswith(".bin") or p.endswith(".gz") or p.endswith(".db"):continue
   if (Path(name).suffix.lower() not in allowed and name not in ("Dockerfile","Makefile","environment","ecosystem.config.js","start.sh","stop.sh")):continue
   try:
    st=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_size>200000:stats["skipped_large"]+=1;continue
    with open(p,"rb") as h:b=h.read()
    stats["files_scanned"]+=1
    for k,pat in patterns.items():
     if pat.encode() in b: hits[k].append(p)
   except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
  if stats["truncated"]:break
 if stats["truncated"]:break
report={"mode":"read_only","scope":"operational_sources_and_service_config","stats":stats,"matches":{k:{"count":len(v),"files":v[:24]} for k,v in hits.items()}}
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True))
